mapper.select: SELECT order_id,CAST(SUM(amount) AS CHAR) amount FROM payment_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='SUCCEEDED' AND order_id IN #{id} GROUP BY order_id
SELECT FROM payment_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND case_id=#{caseId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM payment_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM payment_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_refund SET status='SUCCEEDED',version=version+1,channel_transaction_id=#{transaction},evidence_json=#{proof} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id=#{id} AND status='UNKNOWN'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id>#{after} ORDER BY refund_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_refund_sandbox(tenant_id,refund_id,order_id,amount,currency,status) VALUES(#{tenant},#{view.refundId},#{view.orderId},#{view.amount},#{view.currency},'UNKNOWN') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE refund_id=refund_id
mapper.select: SELECT refund_id,tenant_id,order_id,CAST(amount AS CHAR) amount,currency,status,transaction_id FROM payment_refund_sandbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_refund_sandbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',transaction_id=#{transaction} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id=#{id} AND status='UNKNOWN'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,refund_id,check_attempts FROM payment_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='UNKNOWN' AND check_attempts<5 AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_check_at,refund_id LIMIT 5
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM payment_refund WHERE tenant_id>#{after} AND status='UNKNOWN' AND check_attempts<5 AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT 4
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_refund SET check_attempts=check_attempts+1,next_check_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delay},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE tenant_id=#{check.tenantId} AND refund_id=#{check.refundId} AND check_attempts=#{check.checkAttempts} AND check_attempts<5 AND status='UNKNOWN' AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
